question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'emerge'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1 is '**emerge**'.
 
• The sentence talks about the surprise or shock that would have been experienced by the speaker's grandmother upon witnessing money "**emerge**" from machines.
 
• The context suggests a sudden appearance or coming into view of something unexpected, which fits well with the idea of money appearing from ATMs after the user interacts with the machine.

 

**Correct Passage:__** *Money does not come from trees, as my grandmother used to say; But seeing it __**emerge**__ from machines would shock her! Slip a card into a machine, press a couple of buttons and find new and fresh notes carrying out of a space this is a standard undertaking today. Today, ATMs, or automated teller machines, can be found in most towns and cities. You are able to withdraw cash at any time, day or night, because they typically (2) ______ around the clock.*

*In 1968, Don Wetzel, along with Tom Barnes and George Chastan, developed the first modern and successful ATM in the United States. Although the ATM concept was first (3) ______ in 1968, a functional prototype was constructed in 1969, and Docutel was granted a patent in 1973. A 'data terminal' is all an ATM is. A point where data can be entered or retrieved via a link to the 'Boss-in-Charge', a large computer known as a host processor, is referred to as a 'data terminal'. Many of these terminals are connected to this host processor, which is spread out (4) _______ the city or country. Usually, the host processor belongs to the bank. If it is a dial-up device, it connects to the various terminals via a modem and telephone line.*

*Alternately, the host processor may establish a 'leased line connection' with all ATMs. This indicates that a modem is not required to dial into a single telephone line that is solely dedicated to the host processor. This line can only be used by you. It is always accessible to the boss-in-charge for his or her exclusive use. These exclusive lines are expensive, but they are useful in areas where daily transactions are extremely high. The host processor connects to the ATMs via either a dial-up or leased line connection, (5) ______ on the bank and the number of customers it serves.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **grow** - To increase or develop in size or quantity, often referring to plants or organisms.
 
• **discover** - To find or uncover something previously unknown or unseen.
 
• **create** - To produce or bring something into existence, often through imagination or effort.
